description: Erection of a single storey and part first floor rear extension incorporating a subdivision of the plot.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: Drawings 1/01(Rev.7), 1/02(7), 1/03(7), 1/04(7), 1/05(7), 1/06(7), 1/07(7), 1/08(7), 1/09(7), 1/10(7), 1/11(7), 1/12(7), 1/13(7), 1/14(7), 1/15(7), 1/16(7), 1/17(7) and 1/18(7), received 18/10/2023, and Resubmission Statement and Planning Fire Safety Strategy (July 2023), received 23/08/2023.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Condition : 5 - No additional windows or openings shall be formed in the side elevations of the development hereby permitted.
